maria_support: Customer ACME reported a huge billing spike for embeddings + rerank. Dashboard shows ~12k embedding units for 2026-03-09, invoice shows ~48k. They attached sample request IDs and say it started right after the async-batch rollout yesterday. Ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/t/123456
liam_sre: Can you paste a few of the request IDs and the approximate timestamps? Also whether they were using pairwise rerank or per-input embeddings. Any CSV they attached?
maria_support: They attached a small CSV and three request IDs: abc123, def456, ghi789. Timestamps around 2026-03-09T18:02:xxZ. Customer says payloads were bulk rerank calls via async batch (batch_size ~64). dims in payload header reported as 1536.
evan_ml: Putting initial hypothesis here: the async-batch rewrite deployed yesterday had an edge-case where rerank pairwise accounting and per-input embedding accounting were both incremented when a fallback codepath triggered due to a dim/header mismatch. That would multiply charges (pairwise + per-item). I'll paste relevant log snippets below.
evan_ml: ```
2026-03-09T18:02:12Z batch_id=0x7f9a2c req=abc123 worker=runtime WARN inconsistent_dim expected=1536 seen=1537 -> routing to fallback
2026-03-09T18:02:12Z metering batch_id=0x7f9a2c req=abc123 count_increment pairwise=2016 per_input=64
2026-03-09T18:02:12Z billing_pipe INFO enqueue event_id=evt-0xabc req=abc123 tokens=2016
```
liam_sre: That log line looks bad. If both counters are incremented the billing pipeline would double/ triple count depending on rerun. Do we know why seen=1537? Customer said dims 1536 in CSV.
evan_ml: Two possibilities: 1) client sent malformed header (rare), 2) our async packaging inserted a separator token and the header read became off-by-one in a specific path (more likely given rollout changes). I reproduced locally with a short script.
evan_ml: Repro steps (quick):
1) curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/async/rerank -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"batch": [...], "mode":"pairwise", "async":true}' - include header `X-Vector-Dim: 1537` to simulate malformed client
2) Or run python repro: 
```
# simulate async packer bug
from redwood import AsyncClient
c = AsyncClient()
batch = ["short text"]*64
# intentionally mismatch header
c.send_rerank(batch, dim=1536, raw_header_dim=1537)
```
Expected: fallback route triggers but should only increment pairwise OR per-input, not both. Observed: both counters increment.
billing-bot: Invoice check: spike aligns with 2026-03-09 18:00 UTC deployment. Affected invoice ids: INV-2026-03-MAR-4567. We temporarily applied a credit of $650 to ACME as a goodwill while you triage. Dashboard metric link: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/embeddings-metering?range=24h&panel=batch_ingest
ops-analytics: I pulled metering events and see pattern: event stream shows duplicate events for same request_id with different metering_type tags ("pairwise", "per_input"). Dedupe by request_id currently occurs later in pipeline but only for identical event signatures; different tags escape dedupe.
evan_ml: Fix plan: patch runtime so that fallback path sets a single canonical metering tag and never increments both counters. PR ready: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/7890. Hotfix to staging in ~45m, smoke tests, then can push to prod in ~2h if green. Also propose adding request_id-level dedupe earlier in billing ingress to drop duplicate metering events regardless of tag.
liam_sre: Can you include a minimal repro script in the PR so SRE can run it in staging? Also include logs assertion that only one metering event emitted.
evan_ml: Will add the repro and an integration test. Also will add a temporary migration script to scan last 48h of events and mark duplicates for crediting calculations.
maria_support: Thanks. I'll message the customer: we've issued a temporary credit, engineering will rollout a fix and follow up with RCA and final adjustment. Please ping here when hotfix is live so I can update ticket 123456.
evan_ml: Ping: hotfix landed in staging. Running smoke tests now. ETA to prod ~1.5h.
liam_sre: :thumbsup: once prod is up we'll run billing reconciliation for the window and prepare final credit numbers.
maria_support: Noted. I'll schedule a short customer update in 90m. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
